notes.title: Magnetik update
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We care deeply about our games, and based on your feedback, we're updating Magnetik. The new features in this version include:

[olist]
- The life system is gone! Now, you don’t have to worry about losing progress due to a typo or getting stuck.

- No more checkpoints—each level you complete will automatically save.

- You can now replay any level you like. To make this possible, we've developed a minimalist and clean level selection menu.
[/olist]
We hope these changes make your gameplay even more enjoyable and fun. Thank you!
